pages.text: Visit block positions in range and execute the child, optionally delaying between blocks and exposing position variables.

pages.title: Default Aether Cost
pages.text: Add the body costs for every actual repetition. Loops do not discount damage or materials.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.2 + L(n)*C for at most n blocks. Per-block waiting does not charge complexity again.
